title: Add 2.13 to Release Compatibility Matrix and CUDA Support Matrix
body:
## Summary

- Add the PyTorch **2.13** row to the Release Compatibility Matrix (Python `>=3.10, <=3.15` with 3.15t experimental, C++17, stable CUDA 12.6/13.0, experimental CUDA 13.2, ROCm 7.2, including NCCL versions).
- Extend the **PyTorch CUDA Support Matrix** heading to cover both 2.12 and 2.13.

The CUDA versions in the new row match the existing CUDA Support Matrix rows (12.6.3 / 13.0.2 / 13.2.1).

## Test Plan

Docs-only change. Verified by inspection that the new matrix row is consistent with the CUDA Support Matrix.

*This PR was authored with the assistance of an AI coding agent.*
